Welcome to Tini Jane Studio  Your Wellness & Beauty Sanctuary in Amsterdam

A women-only, home based spa studio in Amsterdam, where professional massage therapy meets a warm, private, and calming atmosphere. This channel is your space for wellness education, self-care inspiration, and behind-the-scenes studio life

🎥 What you'll find here:

Swedish Massage
Deep Tissue Massage
Hot Stone Massage
Shiatsu Massage
Chinesse Massage
Lymphatic Drainage Massage
Tingle Therapy & ASMR Relaxation
Aromatherapy Massage
Face Lymphatic Massage
Head Massage
Foot Care & Thai Foot Massage
Home Spa Environment Guides

About Tini Jane -
Certified massage therapist. 5-star rated on Treatwell. Passionate about helping every woman relax, heal, and feel her best.

📅 Book: www.tinijanestudio.com
🔗 All links: beacons.ai/tinijanestudio
📸 Instagram: @tinijanestudio

Subscribe and join the journey because you deserve to feel good  inside and out
